NL: Who are the owners of the programs that broadcast both in the morning and at night?

Axioms.axiom3: ∀c0∀c1∀c2∀c0'∀c1'∀c2'( broadcast(c0, c1, c2) ∧ broadcast(c0', c1', c2') ∧ c0 = c0' ∧ c1 = c1' ) → ( c2 = c2' )
Axioms.axiom4: ∀d0∀d1∀d2∀d3∀d0'∀d1'∀d2'∀d3'( broadcast_share(d0, d1, d2, d3) ∧ broadcast_share(d0', d1', d2', d3') ∧ d0 = d0' ∧ d1 = d1' ) → ( d2 = d2' ∧ d3 = d3' )
Axioms.axiom5: ∀c0∀c1∀c2 ( broadcast(c0, c1, c2) → ∃a0∃a1∃a2∃a3∃a4 ( program(a0, a1, a2, a3, a4) ∧ a0 = c1 ) )
Axioms.axiom6: ∀c0∀c1∀c2 ( broadcast(c0, c1, c2) → ∃b0∃b1∃b2∃b3∃b4 ( channel(b0, b1, b2, b3, b4) ∧ b0 = c0 ) )
Axioms.axiom7: ∀d0∀d1∀d2∀d3 ( broadcast_share(d0, d1, d2, d3) → ∃a0∃a1∃a2∃a3∃a4 ( program(a0, a1, a2, a3, a4) ∧ a0 = d1 ) )
Axioms.axiom8: ∀d0∀d1∀d2∀d3 ( broadcast_share(d0, d1, d2, d3) → ∃b0∃b1∃b2∃b3∃b4 ( channel(b0, b1, b2, b3, b4) ∧ b0 = d0 ) )
